exposure: mode of delivery of the second twin
cohort: 93 pairs of twins delivered at >28 weeks of gestation
finding: While cesarean delivery was the preferred mode for most twins, it did not significantly influence neonatal morbidity in the second twin, except for a higher likelihood of an Apgar score ≤7 at 1 minute in the vaginal delivery group.
mod_finding: There is an increased preference for cesarean delivery in twin pregnancies except in cases where both the twins are in vertex position and not associated with any other maternal or fetal complication.
